scripts.name: Iron world
scripts.desc: Finds a terrestrial planet having >= 60% of iron in its interior.

scripts.name: Venus analog
scripts.desc: Finds a non-gas planet with atmosphere pressure >= 50 bar.

scripts.name: Asteroid
scripts.desc: Finds an asteroid (a body with mass <= 10<sup>-4</sup> M⊕).

scripts.name: Lava world
scripts.desc: Finds a hot terrestrial planet having a lava ocean.

scripts.name: Mega-Earth
scripts.desc: Finds a terrestrial planet with mass >= 10 M⊕.

scripts.name: Chtonian planet
scripts.desc: Finds a heavy hot terrestrial planet orbiting its star very closely.

scripts.name: Tatooine
scripts.desc: Finds a warm circumbinary terrestrial planet.

scripts.name: Ocean world
scripts.desc: Finds a planet having a deep global liquid water ocean.

scripts.name: Earth 2
scripts.desc: Finds an Earth analog orbiting a G-class star.

scripts.name: Hot Jupiter/Neptune
scripts.desc: Finds a sub-Neptune or a giant planet with temperature >= 900K.

scripts.name: A giant around a red dwarf
scripts.desc: Finds a giant planet (>= 15 M⊕) around a red dwarf.

scripts.name: Hybrid giant
scripts.desc: Finds a sub-Neptune or a giant planet with ~1:1 ice to gas ratio.

scripts.name: Brown dwarf
scripts.desc: Finds a brown dwarf planet (mass >= 4100 M⊕ (12.9 M♃)).

scripts.name: Mega-Neptune
scripts.desc: Finds an ice giant with mass >= 90 M⊕.

scripts.name: Binary giants
scripts.desc: Finds a pair of co-orbiting gas giants or sub-Neptunes with a mass ratio >= 1:25.

scripts.name: Massive moon
scripts.desc: Finds a massive moon that is technically a component of a binary with mass ratio lesser than 1:25.

scripts.name: Twin Earths
scripts.desc: Finds a binary planetary system of habitable meso-Earths.

scripts.name: Retrograde moon
scripts.desc: Finds a moon on a retrograde orbit.

scripts.name: Circumbinary moon
scripts.desc: Finds a circumbinary moon (a common moon of a binary planet).

scripts.name: Pandora
scripts.desc: Finds a habitable big moon orbiting a giant planet.

scripts.name: Ammonia life
scripts.desc: Finds a planet hosting life in ammonia water ocean.

scripts.name: Methane life
scripts.desc: Finds a planet hosting life in methane ocean.

scripts.name: Civilization
scripts.desc: Finds a planet hosting sapient life.

scripts.name: Ringed planet
scripts.desc: Finds a planet having rings.
